summary.name: Sticker Collage (Printmaking and Craft Materials), a normalized label. A dark-field variant, Neon Flat-Sticker Collage on Black, is also defined.
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: uniform white die-cut borders and light contact shadows on paper, notebooks or a simple surface. Stickers are placed, peeled and slightly rotated at constant border scale. Floating stickers are excluded.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: playful arrangements of existing subjects, with the default look for tactile or cosy topics. The neon variant suits energetic, high-contrast tutorials or explainers. Inferred: avoid sticker-explainer pairings, which would duplicate it.
summary.limitations: Explicit: keep border width constant; the neon variant drops contact shadows. Avoid generative smear morphs and roughening every cutout edge. Procedural curl is artistic, not a physics solver. Source review covered sampled seconds 1–8 only, without audio.
summary.palette: Explicit: background is scene-dependent and no approved exact colours were supplied. Illustrative tokens: background #F3EBD9 (not required), foreground #273F49 (9.346:1 on it), border #FFFFFF. Accents #D78267 and #77A397 are decorative only, under 4:1 with foreground. Gradients are disabled.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: placing, peeling, lifting and slight rotation through layer transforms, with pops or slides on deliberate cues, then holds. Optional: mo.js bursts, paper curl, Motion. Motion references 037 and 038 apply only when assets support them. No automatic springs or bounce.
summary.audio: Unspecified by the style; no audio layer is mandatory. Suggested per topic: music, voiceover, sparse placement sounds, ambience or silence, never competing with narration. No audio was supplied. Any soundtrack must be real, verified audio.
summary.assetRequirements: Explicit: alpha-masked cutouts expanded to uniform white borders, approved local fonts, exact copy, and actual punctuation or glyphs for motion-037/038. Do not invent brand marks or copy. No photos or website captures were supplied.
summary.combinations: Explicit optional hybrids: style-025 doodle characters (foreground linework; coral and sage fills only) and style-024 notebook annotations (foreground ink, coral emphasis, never on borders). Use them only when stickers need characters or notes.
summary.productionApproach: SVG style renderer; PixiJS for large sprite sets; Rough.js only for sketch interiors. One owner per animated property. HyperFrames is the default pipeline, with a paused GSAP timeline in window.__timelines; Remotion only as a recorded fallback. Verify seeks and composited contrast.
